H0005.name: Abagtha
H0005.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0005.brief: One of King Ahasuerus' seven eunuchs
H0005.short: Abagtha was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

H0021.name: Abi
H0021.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0021.brief: Mother of King Hezekiah of Judah
H0021.short: Abi, also known as Abijah, was the mother of King Hezekiah and the daughter of Zechariah.

H0029J.name: Abiah
H0029J.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0029J.brief: Wife of Hezron, who gave birth after he died
H0029J.short: Abiah was the wife of Hezron who bore Ashhur after her husband's death.

H0045.name: Abi-albon
H0045.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0045.brief: One of David's mighty men, an Arbathite
H0045.short: Abi-albon, also known as Abiel, was one of David's mighty men, an Arbathite.

H0054.name: Abiathar
H0054.desc: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H0054.brief: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon
H0054.short: Abiathar, son of Ahimelech, was a high priest who served during the reigns of David and Solomon.

H0028.name: Abida
H0028.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0028.brief: Son of Midian, grandson of Abraham
H0028.short: Abida was a son of Midian and a grandson of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.

H0027.name: Abidan
H0027.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0027.brief: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus
H0027.short: Abidan, son of Gideoni, was the leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

H0022G.name: Abiel
H0022G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0022G.brief: Father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul
H0022G.short: Abiel, also known as Jeiel, Ner, or Abigibeon (or '[re]-founder of Gibeon'), was the father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul.

H0044H.name: Abiezer
H0044H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0044H.brief: Son of Hammolecheth, from the tribe of Manasseh
H0044H.short: Abiezer, son of Hammolecheth, was a descendant of Manasseh and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

H0044G.name: Abiezer
H0044G.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0044G.brief: One of David's mighty men, from Anathoth
H0044G.short: Abiezer the Anathothite was one of David's mighty men and served as a commander in his army.

H0044I.name: Abiezer
H0044I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0044I.brief: Clan of Manasseh, home of Gideon
H0044I.short: Abiezer, also known as Iezer, was a clan of the tribe of Manasseh and the home of Gideon, one of Israel's judges.

H0026G.name: Abigail
H0026G.desc: David's wife living at the time of United Monarchy
H0026G.brief: Wife of Nabal, later married David
H0026G.short: Abigail, initially the wife of Nabal, became one of David's wives after Nabal's death and bore him a son named Chileab.

H0026H.name: Abigail
H0026H.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H0026H.brief: Sister of David; mother of Amasa
H0026H.short: Abigail, David's sister, was the mother of Amasa, who became the commander of Absalom's army.

H0032H.name: Abihail
H0032H.desc: Woman of living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0032H.brief: Wife of Abishur; mother of Ahban and Molid
H0032H.short: Abihail was the wife of Abishur and the mother of Ahban and Molid, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H0032I.name: Abihail
H0032I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0032I.short: Abihail, a descendant of Guni, was a leader of the tribe of Gad who lived in Gilead.

H0032J.name: Abihail
H0032J.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0032J.short: Abihail was the mother of Mahalath, who was one of King Rehoboam's wives and the daughter of David's son Jerimoth.

H0032K.name: Abihail
H0032K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0032K.short: Abihail was the father of Esther (also known as Hadassah), who became Queen of Persia and saved the Jewish people from Haman's plot.

H0032G.name: Abihail
H0032G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0032G.brief: Father of Zuriel, a Levite leader
H0032G.short: Abihail was the father of Zuriel, who was the leader of the Merarite clan of the Levites during the wilderness wanderings.

H0030.name: Abihu
H0030.desc: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0030.short: Abihu was a son of Aaron who served as a priest. (<ref="Exo.6.23">Exo.6.23</ref>)

H0031.name: Abihud
H0031.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0031.short: Abihud was a son of Bela and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

H0029L.name: Abijah
H0029L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0029L.brief: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
H0029L.short: Abijah was the head of the eighth priestly division established during King David's reign, and Zechariah, the father of John the Baptist, belonged to this division.

H0029K.name: Abijah
H0029K.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0029K.short: Abijah was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

H0029H.name: Abijah
H0029H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0029H.brief: Son of Jeroboam I, died in childhood
H0029H.short: Abijah, the son of King Jeroboam I, fell ill and died in childhood, as prophesied by Ahijah the prophet.

H0029I.name: Abijah
H0029I.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0029I.brief: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam
H0029I.short: Abijah, the son of Rehoboam, reigned as king of Judah for three years and continued in the sins of his father.

forms.meaning: “my father is the sea” or “Yah(u) is (my) father”

H0029G.name: Abijah
H0029G.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H0029G.brief: Son of Samuel, a corrupt judge
H0029G.short: Abijah was one of Samuel's sons who served as a judge in Israel but did not follow his father's righteous ways.

H0029M.name: Abijah
H0029M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0029M.short: Abijah was one of the priests who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time and was also listed among the priests who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H0039.name: Abimael
H0039.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0039.brief: Descendant of Shem, son of Joktan
H0039.short: Abimael was a descendant of Shem and one of the sons of Joktan, as mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H0040G.name: Abimelech
H0040G.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0040G.brief: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac
H0040G.short: Abimelech was a Philistine king who had dealings with both Abraham and Isaac, involving incidents where the patriarchs claimed their wives were their sisters.
H0040G.meaning: “Melek is father” or “my father is king”

forms.meaning: “Melek is father” or “my father is king”

H0040H.name: Abimelech
H0040H.brief: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem
H0040H.short: Abimelech, a son of Gideon, declared himself king of Shechem but was eventually killed when a millstone was dropped on his head during the siege of Thebez.
H0040H.meaning: “Melek is father” or “my father is king”

forms.meaning: “Melek is father” or “my father is king”

H0041J.name: Abinadab
H0041J.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0041J.brief: Solomon's son-in-law, an official in his government
H0041J.short: Abinadab, the son of Iddo, was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath and served as an official in Solomon's government, overseeing the region of Dor.
H0041J.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

forms.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

H0041H.name: Abinadab
H0041H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0041H.brief: Son of King Saul, killed in battle
H0041H.short: Abinadab, also known as Ishvi, was one of the sons of King Saul who died alongside his father and brothers in battle against the Philistines at Mount Gilboa.
H0041H.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

forms.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

H0041I.name: Abinadab
H0041I.desc: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
H0041I.brief: Son of Jesse, brother of David
H0041I.short: Abinadab was one of the sons of Jesse and an older brother of King David, but he was not chosen to be anointed as king by Samuel.
H0041I.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

forms.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

H0041G.name: Abinadab
H0041G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0041G.brief: Kept the ark of God in his house
H0041G.short: Abinadab, in whose house the ark of God was kept for 20 years.
H0041G.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

forms.meaning: “my father is noble” or “my father is willing”

H0042.name: Abinoam
H0042.brief: Father of Barak, the Israelite commander
H0042.short: Abinoam was the father of Barak, the Israelite commander who, along with the prophetess Deborah, led the Israelites to victory against the Canaanite army led by Sisera.

H0048H.name: Abiram
H0048H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0048H.brief: Firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite
H0048H.short: Abiram, the firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite, died when his father laid the foundation of Jericho.
H0048H.meaning: “my father is exalted” or “(the) Exalted One is (my) father”

forms.meaning: “my father is exalted” or “(the) Exalted One is (my) father”

H0048G.name: Abiram
H0048G.desc: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0048G.brief: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron
H0048G.short: Abiram, along with Korah and Dathan, led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron and was swallowed up by the earth.
H0048G.meaning: “my father is exalted” or “(the) Exalted One is (my) father”

forms.meaning: “my father is exalted” or “(the) Exalted One is (my) father”

H0049.name: Abishag
H0049.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H0049.brief: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David
H0049.short: Abishag, the beautiful Shunammite who served King David in his old age and was later sought as a wife by Adonijah.

H0052.name: Abishai
H0052.desc: David's warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0052.brief: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders
H0052.short: Abishai, the son of Zeruiah and nephew of David, was a loyal commander and one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and military prowess.
H0052.meaning: “my father is Jesse” or “my father is a gift”

forms.meaning: “my father is Jesse” or “my father is a gift”

H0050G.name: Abishua
H0050G.desc: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0050G.brief: Son of Phinehas, grandson of Eleazar the high priest
H0050G.short: Abishua was the son of Phinehas and grandson of Eleazar, who served as high priests in the line of Aaron.
H0050G.meaning: “my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence”

forms.meaning: “my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence”

H0050H.name: Abishua
H0050H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0050H.brief: Descendant of Benjamin, son of Bela
H0050H.short: Abishua was a descendant of Benjamin and one of the sons of Bela mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.
H0050H.meaning: “my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence”

forms.meaning: “my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence”

H0051.name: Abishur
H0051.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0051.brief: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah
H0051.short: Abishur, the son of Shammai, was a descendant of Judah; he married Abihail, and they had two sons, Ahban and Molid.

H0037.name: Abital
H0037.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H0037.brief: One of David's wives; mother of Shephatiah
H0037.short: Abital was one of King David's wives and the mother of his son Shephatiah.

H0036.name: Abitub
H0036.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0036.short: Abitub was a son of Shaharaim, a Benjaminite, and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H0074.name: Abner
H0074.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H0074.brief: Saul's cousin and commander of his army
H0074.short: Abner, the son of Ner, was King Saul's cousin and the commander of his army; he later supported Saul's son Ish-bosheth as king before defecting to David.

H0085.name: Abraham
H0085.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0085.brief: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people
H0085.short: Abraham, originally named Abram, was the patriarch whom God called to leave his homeland and blessed to become the father of many nations, establishing His covenant with him and his descendants.
H0085.meaning: “father of a multitude” or “chief of multitude”

forms.meaning: “father of a multitude” or “chief of multitude”

H0053.name: Absalom
H0053.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H0053.brief: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.
H0053.short: Absalom was David's third son who led a revolt against his father's reign.

H0090H.name: Agag
H0090H.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H0090H.brief: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel
H0090H.short: Agag, king of the Amalekites, was spared by Saul but killed by Samuel.

H0090G.name: Agag
H0090G.desc: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0090G.brief: King mentioned in Balaam's oracle about Israel
H0090G.short: Agag, a king, is mentioned in Balaam's prophetic oracle about Israel's future.

H0089.name: Agee
H0089.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0089.brief: Father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men
H0089.short: Agee the Hararite was the father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men.

H0094.name: Agur
H0094.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0094.brief: Author of Proverbs 30, son of Jakeh
H0094.short: Agur, son of Jakeh, is credited as the author of Proverbs 30.

H0043.name: Ebiasaph
H0043.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0043.brief: Levite descendant of Korah, ancestor of temple gatekeepers
H0043.short: Ebiasaph, also known as Abiasaph or Asaph, was a Levite descendant of Korah and an ancestor of temple gatekeepers.

H0078.name: Ibzan
H0078.brief: A judge of Israel from Bethlehem.
H0078.short: Ibzan was a judge of Israel who led the nation for seven years, had thirty sons and thirty daughters, and was buried in Bethlehem.

H0071.name: Abana
H0071.brief: A river of Damascus, preferred by Naaman over the Jordan.
H0071.short: Abana, a river near Damascus, which Naaman saw as superior to the Jordan River.

H0059G.name: Abel
H0059G.brief: A large stone in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
H0059G.short: Abel, a large stone in Joshua's field at Beth-shemesh, where the Ark stopped.

H0062.name: Abel-beth-maacah
H0062.brief: A city in northern Israel, also called Abel-maim.
H0062.short: Abel-beth-maacah, a fortified city in northern Israel, near Dan.

H0064.name: Abel-keramim
H0064.brief: A place near Ammon, attacked by Jephthah.
H0064.short: Abel-keramim, a town near Ammon, destroyed by Jephthah during his battles against the Ammonites.

H0065.name: Abel-meholah
H0065.brief: A town in Israel, home of Elisha.
H0065.short: Abel-meholah, a town in Israel, the birthplace of Elisha.

H0072.name: Ebenezer
H0072.brief: A stone memorial set up by Samuel to commemorate victory.
H0072.short: Ebenezer was a stone memorial set up by Samuel to commemorate Israel's victory over the Philistines (<ref="1Sa.4.1; 5:1; 7:12">1Sa.4.1; 5:1; 7:12</ref>).

H0077.name: Ebez
H0077.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Issachar.
H0077.short: Ebez was a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar (<ref="Joshua 19:20">Joshua 19:20</ref>).

H0097.name: Eglaim
H0097.brief: Moabite city; its destruction prophesied by Isaiah
H0097.short: Eglaim, a Moabite city whose destruction was prophesied by Isaiah.

H0088.name: Oboth
H0088.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during the Exodus
H0088.short: Oboth was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their journey through the wilderness after the Exodus from Egypt.

H0011.name: Abaddon
H0011.brief: The angel of the bottomless pit, meaning "destruction"
H0011.short: Abaddon (Hebrew) or Apollyon (Greek), meaning "destruction" or "destroyer," is the name of the angel of the bottomless pit  and the name of the pit itself.

H0024G.name: Abib
H0024G.brief: The first month of the Hebrew religious calendar
H0024G.short: Abib, later known as Nisan, was the first month of the Hebrew religious calendar, in which the Passover was celebrated .
